children: Overview
China oil and gas producer's H1 revenue rose 5.3% yr/yr to RMB 1.53 trln
Net income attributable to shareholders grew 22% yr/yr to RMB 103.9 bln
Company declared interim dividend of RMB 0.26 per share
Outlook
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for the current or future periods
Result Drivers
OPERATING PERFORMANCE - Co cited overall operating results and financial position as factors supporting interim dividend declaration
CONSOLIDATION IMPACT - Co consolidated financial statements of new gas storage subsidiaries in H1 2026, which may have affected results

The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 16 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
